cradle.definition:
n. a baby bed with sides and rockers
n. birth of a person
v. hold gently and carefully
v. bring up from infancy
cradle.translation:
n. 摇篮, 发祥地, 孩提时代
vt. 放在摇篮内, 抚育
vi. 刈割

cradle-robber.translation: 〈非正式〉和比自己年轻得多的人恋爱或结婚的人,吃嫩草的老牛,主要用于美式英语

cradle-snatch.translation: vi. 与比自己年轻得多的人结婚(或恋爱)

cradle-snatcher.translation: 与比自己年轻得多的人发生性关系者

cradled.translation: vt. 将…置于摇篮中（cradle的过去式与过去分词形式）

cradles.definition:
n a baby bed with sides and rockers
n where something originated or was nurtured in its early existence
n birth of a person
n a trough that can be rocked back and forth; used by gold miners to shake auriferous earth in water in order to separate the gold
v hold gently and carefully
v bring up from infancy
v hold or place in or as if in a cradle
v cut grain with a cradle scythe
v wash in a cradle
v run with the stick
cradles.translation: n. 摇篮( cradle的名词复数 ); 发源地; 吊架; 婴儿时期

cradlesong.definition:
n a quiet song intended to lull a child to sleep
n the act of singing a quiet song to lull a child to sleep
cradlesong.translation: n. 摇篮曲, 催眠曲

cradling.definition:
v hold gently and carefully
v bring up from infancy
v hold or place in or as if in a cradle
